main.name: apt_exact_factor_pricing
main.statement:
theorem apt_exact_factor_pricing {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ)
    (a : ι → ℝ) (β : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (h_no_arb : ∀ w : ι → ℝ,
      portfolioReturn s w (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) = 0 →
      (∀ k ∈ t, portfolioReturn s w (fun i ↦ β i k) = 0) →
      portfolioReturn s w a = 0) :
    ∃ (lam0 : ℝ) (lam : κ → ℝ), ∀ i ∈ s, a i = lam0 + ∑ k ∈ t, β i k * lam k
main.proof:
by
  have main : ∀ t : Finset κ, ∀ a : ι → ℝ,
      (∀ w : ι → ℝ, portfolioReturn s w (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) = 0 →
        (∀ k ∈ t, portfolioReturn s w (fun i ↦ β i k) = 0) →
        portfolioReturn s w a = 0) →
      ∃ (lam0 : ℝ) (lam : κ → ℝ), ∀ i ∈ s, a i = lam0 + ∑ k ∈ t, β i k * lam k := by
    intro t
    induction t using Finset.cons_induction with
    | empty =>
        intro a h_no_arb
        obtain ⟨lam0, hlam0⟩ := apt_zero_beta_return_constant s a
          (fun w hw => h_no_arb w hw (by simp))
        exact ⟨lam0, fun _ => (0 : ℝ), fun i hi => by simpa using hlam0 i hi⟩
    | cons k₀ t' hk₀ ih =>
        intro a h_no_arb
        exact apt_factor_insertion_step s t' k₀ hk₀ a β h_no_arb ih
  exact main t a h_no_arb

leaves.name: apt_zero_beta_return_constant
leaves.statement:
theorem apt_zero_beta_return_constant {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ w : ι → ℝ, portfolioReturn s w (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) = 0 → portfolioReturn s w a = 0) :
    ∃ lam0 : ℝ, ∀ i ∈ s, a i = lam0

leaves.name: apt_factor_insertion_step
leaves.statement:
theorem apt_factor_insertion_step {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (k₀ : κ)
    (hk₀ : k₀ ∉ t) (a : ι → ℝ) (β : ι → κ → ℝ)
    (h_no_arb : ∀ w : ι → ℝ,
      portfolioReturn s w (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) = 0 →
      (∀ k ∈ Finset.cons k₀ t hk₀, portfolioReturn s w (fun i ↦ β i k) = 0) →
      portfolioReturn s w a = 0)
    (ih : ∀ a' : ι → ℝ,
      (∀ w : ι → ℝ, portfolioReturn s w (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) = 0 →
        (∀ k ∈ t, portfolioReturn s w (fun i ↦ β i k) = 0) →
        portfolioReturn s w a' = 0) →
      ∃ (lam0 : ℝ) (lam : κ → ℝ), ∀ i ∈ s, a' i = lam0 + ∑ k ∈ t, β i k * lam k) :
    ∃ (lam0 : ℝ) (lam : κ → ℝ), ∀ i ∈ s, a i = lam0 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.cons k₀ t hk₀, β i k * lam k
